title: Devplan Interview
description: A guided planning workspace: adaptive interview, specification, complexity sizing, phased development plan and a circular-development handoff packet. Ships as a static sandboxed UI plus an optional owner-authenticated, tool-free Python interview service. Exports interview, specification and checkpoints as JSON or ZIP.

permissions: Read a deployment config from .runtime/devplan-interview/config.json: Hermes home, Hermes source and python paths, and Orbit origins
Validate the Orbit host token against the local Orbit auth endpoint at the configured loopback URL
Invoke the Hermes runtime once per interview turn to request a model response, with tools disabled
Listen on a loopback HTTP port; a distinct owner-authenticated private HTTPS proxy origin is expected in front
Runs with owner filesystem privileges; declarations are not enforced permissions and there is no reboot supervision
